# graviteeam_org_identity_provider (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM organization-level identity provider

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_org_identity_provider" "example" {
  name = "Org Inline IDP"
  type = "inline-am-idp"
  configuration = jsonencode({
    users = []
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String, Sensitive) JSON configuration for the identity provider (use jsonencode())
- `name` (String) The name of the organization identity provider
- `type` (String) The type of identity provider (e.g. inline-am-idp)

### Optional

- `domain_whitelist` (List of String) List of whitelisted email domains
- `external` (Boolean) Whether this is an external/social identity provider

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization identity provider
